entities.name: Phthalimide substrate C21H18N2O4
observations: Decoded substrate: CN1C(=O)C=CC2=CC(OCCCN3C(=O)C4=CC=CC=C4C3=O)=CC=C21; contains a terminal N-phthalimide protecting group.

entities.name: Deprotected amine C13H16N2O2
observations: Proposed hydrazinolysis product: CN1C(=O)C=CC2=CC(OCCCN)=CC=C21; terminal phthalimide is replaced by primary amine while the fused N-methyl lactam remains intact.
